payload.title: The CMS host redirects public paths to the canonical public host
payload.description: Backlog. When a projection is mounted on another host (productionUrl names a different origin), requests for public pages on the CMS edge host get a 301 to the same path on the public host, so the same pages are not served on two hosts. /newsroom, /_next and /api stay. Gherkin to be written when picked up.
